record.context_brief: Tukey types of weakly compact sets
record.original_question: Is it relatively consistent with ZFC that there exists a separable Banach space X for which the partially ordered set K(B_X) of weakly compact subsets of the closed unit ball B_X, ordered by inclusion, is not Tukey equivalent to any of the four standard types {0}, N^N, K(Q), or the family of finite subsets of the continuum?

evidence.quote: Problem 1.6. Is it relatively consistent that there is a separable Banach space X such that K(B_X) is not Tukey equivalent to {0}, N^N, K(Q) or [𝔠]^{<N}?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
For a topological space Y, let K(Y) denote the family of compact subsets of Y, partially ordered by inclusion. Two directed partially ordered sets (P,≤) and (Q,≤) are said to be Tukey equivalent if each is a Tukey quotient of the other, where P is a Tukey quotient of Q when there exists a map f : Q → P sending cofinal subsets of Q to cofinal subsets of P. 

Consider the following directed partially ordered sets: the trivial one-point order {0}; the Baire space N^N under coordinatewise dominance; K(Q), the family of compact subsets of the rational numbers ordered by inclusion; and [c]^{<ω}, the family of finite subsets of the continuum c, ordered by inclusion.

Now let X be a separable (real) Banach space, let B_X denote its closed unit ball equipped with the weak topology, and let K(B_X) denote the family of weakly compact subsets of B_X, ordered by inclusion.

Question: Is it relatively consistent with ZFC that there exists a separable Banach space X such that K(B_X) is not Tukey equivalent to any of {0}, N^N, K(Q), or [c]^{<ω}?
artifact.category_tag: Tukey order on weakly compact sets
artifact.status_search_result: A targeted web search did not surface a paper resolving the consistency question of whether K(B_X), for some separable Banach space X, can fail to be Tukey-equivalent to any of {0}, N^N, K(Q), or [c]^{<ω}. Related work on the Tukey order of compact subsets of separable metric spaces exists, but no source confirming a solution (positive or negative) was located, so the status remains unverified.

status_evidence.title: The Tukey order on compact subsets of separable metric spaces
status_evidence.snippet: The order structure of K(M)'s under Tukey quotients is investigated, with applications to function spaces and to the complexity of weakly countably determined Banach spaces and Gul'ko compacta.
status_evidence.claim: Demonstrates ongoing research on Tukey types of K(M) but does not resolve the specific consistency question for K(B_X) of separable Banach spaces.
